iti94:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti94:2.1: “Monks, a monk should investigate in such a way that–his consciousness neither externally scattered & diffused, nor internally positioned–he is, from lack of clinging/sustenance, unagitated,
iti94:2.2: and there is no coming into being of the origination of future birth, aging, death, or stress.”
iti94:3.1:
For a monk who has abandoned
seven attachments
iti94:3.3:
the wandering-on in birth
is finished;
iti94:3.4:
there is, for him,
no further becoming.
